freshnessPolicy.general: Recheck when a cited authority/source is revised or superseded; when a browser capability changes availability/requirements; when a dependency/security advisory affects the implementation; or when product behavior changes enough to invalidate recorded tests.

triggers: NIST publishes/revises successor RMF material used by the product
relevant EU AI Act application/legal status changes
ICO human-review guidance is revised from its current under-review state
governed independent semantic evaluator is introduced
real labeled validation data becomes available
Build 004 evidence infrastructure changes the evidence path

001.core: deterministic browser computation; no model/network dependency for assessment
001.failureState: form remains usable without clipboard support; JSON export is an explicit local action

002.heavyAssetPolicy: browser-managed model/translator are requested only after explicit user action and feature detection
002.failureState: visible unavailable/download/failure message; deterministic first value remains

003.heavyAssetPolicy: browser-managed model requested only after explicit user action and feature detection
003.failureState: visible unavailable/download/failure message; deterministic hypotheses and export remain
